content: Claude-BugHunter is an open-source Python skill bundle designed for bug hunting and external red-team operations. The collection comprises 82 specialized skills, 15 slash commands, and 681 disclosed-report patterns covering 24 core vulnerability classes. It also includes enterprise identity and infrastructure attack matrices. The project has accumulated 5,895 stars and 906 forks on its platform.

title: NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator
content: The SkillEvaluator project is a Python-based framework for assessing AI agent capabilities. It features a multi-tier evaluation structure incorporating quality gates and semantic overlap detection to analyze agent skills. The tool generates synthetic datasets and performs live agent evaluations to measure how specific skills influence behavior. Hosted on GitHub, the project has accumulated 1,308 stars and 154 forks. Its primary function is providing a structured, data-driven approach to validating and understanding AI agent skill performance.

title: 黄仁勋吃了上市太早的亏
content: Jensen Huang stepped down as Nvidia’s CEO after 33 years due to his lack of dual-class share protection. Unlike peers, Huang relies on performance authority rather than voting power. His stake, diluted from 13.1% in 1999 to 3.58%, insufficient to control the board. Consequently, the board could remove him at will. This case illustrates that without structural safeguards, founder influence depends on sustained success and can be abruptly reversed when corporate governance mechanisms are triggered.

title: What Breaks When You Scale 10x? | Zipline’s Keller Cliffton
content: Keller Cliffton discusses Zipline’s evolution from an autonomous medical delivery service in Rwanda to a U.S. consumer logistics network. The company began in Rwanda due to regulatory restrictions on autonomous flight in the United States, eventually completing over three million deliveries. Cliffton explains how operating in real-world environments shaped the company’s operational approach and why scaling by a factor of ten requires significant structural reinvention. He also details Zipline’s expansion into home delivery, its special forces-inspired team organization, and his projection that annual U.S. instant delivery demand could reach 50 billion shipments.

title: Why did some Apollo missions carry a grenade launcher? (2019)
content: As a precautionary measure against lunar-based threats, some early Apollo missions included a shotgun loaded with blank cartridges and a small grenade launcher. Consequently, robotics companies are advised to pivot from developing "brains" to providing specialized hardware and real-world data for general AI systems.

This 15th integrated flight marked a historic first for catching a space-rated spacecraft, validating critical technology for future full reusability and lowering the cost of orbital transport. content: Jensen Huang is stepping down as NVIDIA's CEO, with Colette Kress assuming the role temporarily. Future success depends on executing complex technologies like NVHBM and 800V power delivery, a responsibility deeply tied to Huang's personal leadership and industry insight.

content: Nvidia's board has officially responded to CEO succession rumors, clarifying that it is currently selecting an executive search firm. The board confirmed that no formal contact has been made with any potential candidates, emphasizing that speculation regarding specific successors is premature. While the company is preparing for the recruitment process, no timeline has been established. This statement addresses ongoing media reports and internal employee concerns about Jensen Huang’s potential departure, confirming that the search for his successor has not yet formally begun.

title: Runner iPhone 版开启 TestFlight 内测：在手机上看终端、回消息、带 crew 干活
content: Runner, an open-source desktop tool for managing CLI agents, has launched an iPhone TestFlight beta. The mobile app securely connects to a local computer via an end-to-end encrypted relay, allowing users to view sessions, monitor agent crews, and approve decisions. It features a terminal interface using libghostty for rendering native TUIs, includes a draft input mode for easier typing, and supports theme customization. While desktop use remains free, mobile access requires a beta invitation code.

title: 在黄仁勋身上，我看见了他们对华人的恶意 | 原文
content: The author attributes perceived hostility toward Chinese people to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s childhood trauma. The article details his experience in 1973 at Oneida Baptist Institute, a religious reformatory for troubled youth, where he faced bullying and discrimination due to his Asian background and limited English proficiency. The piece suggests these early adversities shaped his later worldview and corporate conduct.
